goal: Use the authenticated Shopee/Lazada affiliate portals to convert approved public source URLs into custom tracking links.
context: The source manifest contains public URLs only. User has authorized portal management, but credentials and tax data must never be stored or logged.
requirements: Open each source in the correct affiliate portal
Generate custom link with existing tracking ID
Record only non-secret URL/product ID/commission evidence
acceptance_criteria: Every active candidate has a valid HTTPS affiliate URL
Commission field is sourced or marked needs_verification
No credentials, tax data or secrets committed
